# Public speech test fixture

`jfk.wav` is a public historical speech excerpt used by the official Transformers.js audio examples, downloaded from:

https://huggingface.co/datasets/Xenova/transformers.js-docs/resolve/main/jfk.wav

It contains part of John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address (a U.S. federal government work). It is a fixed test fixture, not user audio. Browser tests decode it locally and feed it into the speech capture/model pipeline. It is never an example of having tested an actual microphone or a user's emotional speech.
